reasoning: The hot inputChar/spaceChar and output loop are already inlined locally at O2; consumeNonzeroToken remained a call.
The inline variant removed the consumeNonzeroToken symbol and placed fail in cold code, but performance benefit is unproven.
About 88 percent of CPU in the O2/O3 local series is system CPU; this does not measure Windows I/O or server performance.
GCC optimize O3 pragma can override function options, but local Clang O3 is not a validation of GCC pragma behavior/performance.
Avoid AVX2: the published G5420 specification lists SSE4.1/SSE4.2, not AVX2. The replay loop has no demonstrated SIMD workload.
LTO/PGO require compiler/linker workflow support unavailable in the submitted source interface; no demonstrated production gain here.
